integrity: The primary paper was inspected at the exact surface definition, cinematic-curvature conditions, hyperbolic intersection theorem, near-tangency argument, and the quoted level-set theorem. The lower bound was reconstructed independently from an exact rational saddle tangency, the Morse lemma, and a direct Fubini overlap argument. The hyperbolicity of the full parameter rectangle was checked directly from the source definition rather than inferred only from a model remark.
scientific_limitations: The result proves sharpness of the logarithmic factor in the pairwise hyperbolic intersection estimate for an explicit permitted power family. It does not determine the sharp hyperbolic Wolff maximal-operator norm, does not claim every hyperbolic power admits the same displayed translation, and gives order equivalence rather than an exact leading three-dimensional volume coefficient.
title: Saddle tangency makes the hyperbolic BRK logarithm sharp
